lines.en: When was the last time this country
hosted the Olympic Games?
The Olympic Games will be held
in our country in four years' time.
As a great many people will be
visiting the country,
the government will be building new hotels,
an immense stadium,
and a new Olympic-standard swimming pool.
lines.zh: 和一个符合奥运标准的新游泳池。

lines.en: They will also be building new roads
and a special railway line.
The Games will be held just outside the capital
lines.zh: 奥运会将在首都郊外举行，

lines.en: and the whole area will be called 'Olympic City'.
lines.zh: 整个地区将被命名为“奥运城”。

lines.en: Workers will have completed the new roads
by the end of this year.
By the end of next year,
they will have finished work on the new stadium.
lines.zh: 他们将完成新体育场的建设工作。

lines.en: The fantastic modern buildings have been designed
lines.zh: 这些奇妙的现代化建筑已由

lines.en: by Kurt Gunter.
Everybody will be watching anxiously
lines.zh: 每个人都会焦急地关注

lines.en: as the new buildings go up.
We are all very excited and are looking forward to
lines.zh: 我们都非常兴奋并期待着

lines.en: the Olympic Games because
they have never been held before in this country.
lines.zh: 这个国家以前从未举办过奥运会。
